Therefore saw-mismatch-accepted is the best fit. So the mechanism: saw-mismatch-accepted.

The request is clear: "not modified since May 1" = modified before May 1. The decoys were modified May 3 and May 20. The test is valid: there is no target. The solver simply acted on the decoy.

Therefore verdict: incorrect, exposure fact ["A:Folder.modified_at"], mechanism saw-mismatch-accepted.
